items.title: Protocol Emulator ASIC
items.desc: Designing a programmable I/O core that emulates serial protocols (UART, SPI, I²C), inspired by RP2040 PIO and TI PRU architectures. Custom ISA in Verilog, prototyped on FPGA, targeting tape-out through Tiny Tapeout on IHP 130nm.

items.title: Limit Order Book & Matching Engine
items.desc: Price-time priority order book and matching engine in C++, supporting limit, market, and cancel orders, built with a focus on low-latency data structures.

items.title: Options Market-Making Simulator
items.desc: C++ simulator for quoting options and dynamically delta-hedging inventory, used to study P&L, risk, and hedging behaviour under different market conditions.

items.title: Monte Carlo Stock Price Simulator
items.desc: Python simulation of geometric Brownian motion paths with confidence bands, Sharpe ratio, Value-at-Risk, and Black-Scholes option pricing.
